data.one_liner: Platform interface for the audio_service plugin
data.what_it_does: Defines the common API that all platform implementations of audio_service must expose. It allows the plugin and its extensions to interact with platform-specific code through a consistent interface.
use_when: You are writing a new platform implementation for audio_service
You need to ensure that multiple platform plugins adhere to the same contract
avoid_when: You only need the default audio_service plugin without custom platform code
strengths: Easily extendable by new platform implementations
weaknesses: Requires separate platform-specific packages to do work
